This is a preview release. v0.8.3-beta.1 did not resolve the Windows startup crash; this one fixes the actual cause. Please install it on Windows and confirm MuxSU opens and stays on its main screen.

### Fixed

- **Windows: the app vanished a few seconds after opening**: the main window appeared, the whole process then disappeared, and the event log held nothing but a bare `0xc0000409`. Tauri builds every window in its configuration before it calls MuxSU's own startup routine. A window starts loading its interface and asking the backend for data the moment it is built — while that routine had not run a single line, so the shared state those requests need did not exist and the process stopped there. All three windows are now built by the startup routine itself, after the shared state is in place.

  v0.8.3-beta.1 only moved preparing that state to the front of the startup routine, which cannot help when the routine itself has not begun. What gave it away: the log directory never appeared at all, and creating it is the first thing that routine does.

### Known limitations

- Verified on macOS: all three windows build correctly and the interface talks to the backend. The Windows startup problem needs this install to confirm.
- A preview release is never treated as the newest version by the updater, so computers on a stable release will not be upgraded to it automatically.
- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed and not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may ask for it to be allowed by hand.

This version speaks the same protocol as v0.8.2 and pairs and switches with it directly.
